name: White Salmon River
blurb: Spring-fed, ice-cold Wild and Scenic river in a mossy basalt slot — the Gorge's summer rafting run.

sections.notes: Continuous Class III–III+ in a narrow basalt gorge. TAKE OUT ABOVE HUSUM FALLS (Class V) at the river-right USFS access. Commercial rafting run. USFS: no fees at BZ Corner or the Husum Boating Site for private boaters; commercial outfitters need a USFS special-use permit.

notices.title: Scout the take-out above Husum Falls
notices.text: This is a technical whitewater trip. Before launching, identify the exit above Class V Husum Falls and plan your take-out. The Area marker shows the roadside boating facility, not the exact eddy or a navigation target. Do not use the map to decide when to make the exit.

putInAccess.sourceName: USDA Forest Service, Columbia River Gorge NSA: BZ Launch Site & Trail (#4413)
putInAccess.note: USFS confirms the launch, take-outs and trail open; toilets are seasonally closed. INFRA site 76009 matches this existing approximate agency coordinate. The imagery does not establish an exact parking loop or shoreline entry at the pin. The river is east of the marker; retain Area precision and agency directions.
putInAccess.directions: Follow USFS directions to the signed parking east of SR 141 near milepost 12.5, then the 0.1-mile carry trail with boat-slide rails. The agency Area marker is approximate; use the signed entrance, not the marker, to locate parking and the launch.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: USDA Forest Service — Husum (above the falls)
takeOutAccess.note: Current USFS page identifies this boating/portage facility and publishes the unchanged candidate coordinate. Individual imagery places it at the roadside pull-out upstream of the visible falls. Preserve Area precision: the water-entry path and take-out eddy are under tree cover. Missing the upstream exit can lead into Class V Husum Falls.
takeOutAccess.directions: USFS Husum Boating Site is beside SR 141 at approximately milepost 8.8. Before launching, scout and identify the take-out above Husum Falls; the roadside-area marker is not the exact take-out eddy.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
